message.content:
Yes—Atlanta residents can file noise‑related complaints through the city’s official channels. While the “local council” in Atlanta is the City Council, noise complaints are typically handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the city’s **Code Enforcement** office. Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | What to Do | Where / How |
|------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Gather details** – Note the address, time(s) of disturbance, type of noise (e.g., construction, parties, loud music), and any relevant evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings). | — |
| 2 | **Check the city’s website** – Visit the City of Atlanta’s official portal at <https://www.atlantaga.gov/>. Look for the “Report a Problem” or “Noise Complaint” section. | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/> |
| 3 | **File online** – Use the city’s online form for noise complaints. You’ll need to provide your contact information, the location of the disturbance, and a description. | Online form on the city’s portal |
| 4 | **Call the Police Department** – If you prefer to speak directly or if the situation is urgent, call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000**. They can log the complaint and dispatch an officer if needed. | 404‑656‑4000 |
| 5 | **Contact Code Enforcement** – For ongoing or repeated disturbances, you can also reach out to the City’s Code Enforcement office. They handle violations of city ordinances, including noise codes. | 404‑656‑4000 (same line) or visit the Code Enforcement page on the city’s website |
| 6 | **Follow up** – After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up calls or emails. The city may also send you updates via email or text if you opt in. | — |

### Quick Links

- **City of Atlanta “Report a Problem” portal**: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/portal/Report-a-Problem>
- **Atlanta Police Department Non‑Emergency Line**: 404‑656‑4000
- **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement**: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/portal/Code-Enforcement>

### Tips

- **Timing matters** – Noise complaints are most effective when reported during or shortly after the disturbance.
- **Documentation helps** – Attach photos or audio clips if possible; they can support your claim.
- **Know the ordinance** – Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 2 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) specifies permissible hours and decibel limits. Familiarizing yourself with it can strengthen your complaint.

If you’re unsure whether a particular situation falls under the city’s noise ordinance, you can always call the police department’s non‑emergency line for guidance before filing.
